said.q: When Bellows first showed the canvas in the 1910 Independent Artists Exhibition, the work gained quick notoriety and was featured in numerous magazines. Prior to 1916, Bellows had contributed drawings to be translated for magazine publication.

events.n: the subject first executed as an oil painting
events.q: Bellows executed the subject first in 1909 as an oil painting.
